messages:
Sarah (sales): Hey team — need temporary Dedicated headroom + burst for a POC next Tue 4/12 09:00-13:00 PT for AcmeHealth. We need: Dedicated pool bump, burst enabled, ephemeral SSH jumpbox for devs, and a hosted API key for integration smoke tests. Security wants creds to expire and to see rotation plan. Also: any quick cost estimate so we can sign off? cc @Alex M.
Alex M.: Got it. Quick Qs — which model(s), expected concurrency and avg tokens per request, and do you need KV/prefix caching preserved across runs? Also prefer autoscale guardrails or manual guaranteed headroom?
Sarah (sales): Model is open-llama-13b-quant; expected concurrency ~60 concurrent requests, avg 120 tokens, seq len ~1024. We want guaranteed headroom (min capacity) for the window + burst headroom for spikes. Pref manual for now.
Meera K.: Thanks — SRE here. We can do a time-bounded capacity uplift. Proposed change: pool "poc-acme" min 8 -> 12 reserved, max 16, burst factor 2 for the 4-hour window. Will enable ephemeral bastion with SSO + forced key rotation every 12h. Anyone object?
Jamie L.: Finance: rough delta for that uplift is ~$1,200 for the 4h window (GPU hours + burst premium). I'll confirm exact invoice line once Meera posts the final config. :money_with_wings: 
Alex M.: Ops notes — if you want to run low-latency demo, enable KV prefix caching and set batching to 16. Command I'll run (admin):
```
redwoodctl pools update --name poc-acme --min 12 --max 16 --burst 2 --start 2026-04-12T09:00:00-07:00 --end 2026-04-12T13:00:00-07:00 --tags demo,acme
```
I'll also pin model version v1.3.2 to avoid rollouts during demo.
Sarah (sales): Perfect. For SSH: devs need a temporary port-forward to the model container for remote profiling. Can SRE expose a jumpbox with expiry and restrict to Acme IPs?
Meera K.: Yes — we'll create a bastion host reachable only from listed Acme IP ranges + require SSO + MFA. We'll create short-lived jumpbox creds and a GitHub invite for access. Also we'll create an API key for integration tests with scopes [inference:read,inference:write] and expiry at 04/13 09:00 PT. Any additional compliance docs needed?
Sarah (sales): They asked for SOC2 and key management description (KMS/HSM). We'll upload the security questionnaire after you point us to the right docs.
Alex M.: Docs: SOC2 summary + KMS integration page at https://redwood.example.com/compliance (internal). I'll paste the KMS config snippet in the ticket.
infra-bot: Ticket created: #SRE-4829 — Dedicated uplift + bastion provisioning for Acme POC. Assigned to @Meera K. ETA 24h.
Meera K.: I'll schedule the config change tonight and run the update during the maintenance window at 02:00 PT to avoid conflicts. I'll post the ephemeral credentials link here once ready and tag the Acme devs. Also will add a cost-ack flag that requires @Jamie L sign-off before activation.
Jamie L.: Acknowledged. I'll approve the charge once Meera posts the final estimated cost. :white_check_mark: 
Sarah (sales): Thanks — please also leave a short how-to for rotating the API key during the POC. Want to show customers we rotate keys frequently.
Meera K.: Will do. Plan: create API key with 24h TTL, script for rotation (we'll provide `curl` example), and an ops runbook. Expect the creds link + runbook here by EOD. Closing loop: Alex — any other infra gotchas?
Alex M.: Just reminder to set autoscale cooldown to 60s and eviction policy to earliest-first for the demo. I'll validate latency in the staging canary after you provision. Good to go on my end.
Sarah (sales): Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround team :rocket:
